api.linux_behavior: Assigns GLOBAL_LOG_LEVEL; no bounds validation and no Linux environment override. Use defined enum value 6 (LOG_LEVEL_ERROR).
api.global_scope: Process-global Cedar logger state, not per decoder.

crop_warning.macro: omx_logw at base/include/cdc_log.h:94 maps to CDCLOG(LOG_LEVEL_WARNING).
crop_warning.linux_filter: cdc_log.h:67-72 prints only when level >= GLOBAL_LOG_LEVEL; level 6 suppresses crop warning 5 and preserves errors 6.
crop_warning.does_not_fix: Does not stop polling, alter crop values, recover idle failure or change decoder state.

configuration.section_spelling: paramter is the literal vendor spelling; parameter is incorrect.
configuration.misleading_log_literal: CdcLog.c:73 prints /vendor/etc/cedarc.conf even on Linux; use the parser source/binary path, not that log text.
configuration.path_override: No path parameter or environment override in reviewed Linux implementation.

lifetime: CdcIniParserGetInt lazily initializes only when g_ini is NULL; otherwise it reads the cached dictionary. Editing the file alone does not refresh a retained component.
__AwOmxVdecComponentCreate in openmax/vdec/src/omx_vdec.c:2189-2191 explicitly calls CdcIniParserInit, reloading the configured file on component creation.
AwOmxComponentDestrory in openmax/omxcore/aw_omx_component.c:31 calls CdcIniParserDestory, freeing and clearing the dictionary.
AwOmxComponentInit at aw_omx_component.c:45 sets log level from cdc_log_level with default 5.
Linux decoder preparation at omx_vdec_aw_decoder_linux.c:1582-1588 temporarily sets 6 before loading plugins and creating VideoDecoder.

CreateVideoDecoder invokes DebugCheckConfig (vdecoder/vdecoder.c:426), whose normal bShowLogFlag==0 path at 392-396 sets log level from cdc_log_level with default 4. An earlier direct setlevel call can therefore be overwritten.

build_binary_checks.readelf: libcdc_base exports log_setlevel, GLOBAL_LOG_LEVEL, CdcIniParserInit and CdcIniParserDestory. libOmxVdec imports the logger variable/function and CdcIniParserInit.
build_binary_checks.limit: Read-only build-host identity, not a fresh check of the installed board libraries.

recommended_private_binding.prepare: Copy the existing complete cedarc.conf into the experiment's private config directory and change only [paramter] cdc_log_level to 6, preserving other settings. If no config exists, the minimal exact_ini uses vendor defaults for all other keys.
recommended_private_binding.activation: Have root apply the private binding before the next authorized new service process; namespace setup precedes decoder/config initialization. No change to the host-wide configuration is required.
recommended_private_binding.reason: Later decoder initialization consistently reloads the configured level, unlike an early one-off direct log_setlevel call.
recommended_private_binding.rollback: Remove only the experiment-specific drop-in for the next process start. Do not redirect or suppress unrelated stdout/stderr.
